# Noah Grove Music

Noah Grove is a Charleston, South Carolina singer-songwriter, live looping performer, DJ, music producer, open mic host, kitesurfer, basketball player, philosopher, and creative technologist.

Canonical site: https://www.noahgrove.com/
Sitemap: https://www.noahgrove.com/sitemap.xml

- https://www.noahgrove.com/original-music — original music and songwriting context.
- https://www.noahgrove.com/live-looping-charleston — live looping and one-man-band performance in Charleston.

- https://www.noahgrove.com/music-technology — LiveWall, SocialWorker, TimeBrain, Space ARK, and performance systems.
- https://www.noahgrove.com/faq — common questions and long-tail queries.
